headline: Intelbras Third-Quarter Net Profit Rises 20% to R$177 Million
summary: Brazilian hardware manufacturer Intelbras reported a 20% increase in third-quarter net profit to R$177 million. Net revenue grew 4.6% year-over-year to reach R$1.18 billion.
why: Intelbras is a Brazilian technology company producing security systems, telecommunications, and solar power equipment.
